agents.tagline: An agentic AI platform that automates legacy application modernization by deploying a network of 20+ specialized AI agents to map dependencies, decode business logic, and architect cloud-ready transformations.
agents.description: LIFTR.ai (Legacy Insights and Feasibility for Transformation and Recommendation) is an enterprise-grade agentic AI platform that accelerates and de-risks modernization of legacy applications. At its core is an Agentic AI Architect — a network of more than 20 specialized AI agents including Assessment Agents, Code Analysis Agents, Business Logic Agents, Architecture Agents, and Cloud Readiness Agents that collaborate like an expert software engineering team. The platform consists of three modules: Legacy Lifter for codebase analysis and dependency mapping, Data Lifter for schema analysis and migration integrity, and Test Lifter for AI-driven test generation and self-healing validation. It runs entirely on-premises using locally hosted LLMs on NVIDIA GPU clusters, ensuring no code or data leaves client environments, making it suitable for regulated industries.

expected_outcomes: Assessment cycles reduced from months to weeks with 10x faster analysis

agents.tagline: A Gen AI-powered document intelligence platform that extracts, classifies, and converses with unstructured enterprise documents to automate text analytics workflows.
agents.description: teX.ai is a generative AI-powered SaaS document intelligence accelerator that transforms unstructured text data into actionable insights. The platform provides three core functions: Chat for conversational document interaction using contextual knowledge bases, Search for semantic natural-language queries across indexed document collections, and Transform for automated data extraction, entity recognition, and classification from complex documents. It integrates vector databases, prompt stores, human-in-the-loop review workflows, and memory management into a unified platform, with advanced parsing capabilities for hybrid document layouts including tables, charts, images, and infographics. The platform supports multilingual processing and fine-tuning with real-time feedback integration for enterprise-grade accuracy.

contract analysis and due diligence acceleration for legal teams
technical documentation extraction and product review analysis for manufacturing

expected_outcomes: 50-80% effort savings across document processing operations
87% increase in daily processed KYC applications

agents.tagline: An AI-driven smart test automation platform that generates test scripts from plain English and self-heals automation suites using generative AI.
agents.description: uphoriX is an intelligent test automation platform that uses generative AI to streamline automated testing across UI, API, Mobile, and Data domains from a single unified interface. The platform auto-generates ready-to-run test scripts for frameworks including Selenium, Playwright, TestNG, and Cypress from plain English descriptions, and employs AI-driven self-healing to automatically adapt test scripts when application code changes. It features proactive defect prediction and detection, intelligent test orchestration, and continuous optimization based on user behavior patterns. The low-code interface empowers both technical and non-technical users to create and maintain test suites, with real-time monitoring and analytics providing complete visibility into test execution metrics.

use_cases.title: Automated regression test generation and maintenance for enterprise applications
cross-browser and cross-device parallel testing for digital products
CI/CD pipeline integration for continuous quality assurance
legacy test suite modernization with AI-generated scripts

expected_outcomes: test execution effort reduced by up to 80%

agents.tagline: A pre-packaged, on-premises enterprise AI solution that combines optimized hardware, LLM infrastructure, and ready-to-deploy business applications for regulated industries.
agents.description: GenAI in a Box is a pre-packaged enterprise AI solution combining optimized hardware, LLM infrastructure, and ready-to-deploy business applications for on-premises deployment. The platform is built on NVIDIA-supported LLM infrastructure with a curated selection of open-source and pretrained models, offering flexible model selection based on cost, performance, and domain requirements. It includes pre-built configurable applications and industry-specific technology blueprints that reduce development time and shorten deployment cycles. The solution supports localized data storage to reduce cloud dependency, making it suitable for regulated industries such as healthcare and financial services that require strict data security and compliance controls.

cost-optimized LLM deployment with smaller model alternatives
enterprise AI adoption with data sovereignty requirements

expected_outcomes: enhanced data security and regulatory compliance through on-premises hosting

agents.tagline: A generative AI framework that embeds intelligent conversational and agentic capabilities directly into enterprise applications for real-time data interaction.
agents.description: Needle is a custom generative AI framework that enables organizations to design AI agents with complex reasoning, task execution, and interaction with external data sources and APIs. The platform uses advanced NLP and semantic understanding to locate and extract insights from vast and diverse data repositories, integrating with databases to enable real-time queries, uncover trends, and deliver actionable insights. Needle provides two primary integration methods — REST APIs for fine-grained developer control and iFrame embedding for rapid deployment — supporting capabilities including chat interactions, dynamic query processing, context-aware conversations, and token-based authentication. The platform can be deployed on-premises or in the cloud with enterprise-grade security including SSL/TLS encryption, tokenized session management, rate limiting, and compliance with regulatory standards.

expected_outcomes: reduced manual effort in document review and data extraction
